parameters.content:
## Retry (dead-letter → queue)

Reads non-ok lines from the run logs and writes them back into the SAME
pending job queue (`jobs/<pipeline>/retry-<pipeline>-<name>.json`), so the
next worker poll picks them up automatically.

Only failures from the last RETRY_WINDOW_HOURS (default 24) are considered;
RETRY_MAX caps how many are re-enqueued per pass. Already-pending retries are
skipped (idempotent).

parameters.command: RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.RUN_ROOT || '' }}"; if [ -z "$RUN_ROOT" ]; then RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.MULTITOOL_ROOT || '/opt/multi-tool' }}/n8n/runs"; fi; cat "$RUN_ROOT/logs/transit/"*/*.ndjson "$RUN_ROOT/logs/internal/"*/*.ndjson 2>/dev/null | grep -v '"status":"ok"' || true

RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.RUN_ROOT || '' }}"; if [ -z "$RUN_ROOT" ]; then RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.MULTITOOL_ROOT || '/opt/multi-tool' }}/n8n/runs"; fi; mkdir -p "$RUN_ROOT/jobs/{{ $json.pipeline }}"; JOB="$RUN_ROOT/jobs/{{ $json.pipeline }}/{{ $json.chunkId }}.json"; [ -f "$JOB" ] || printf '%s' '{{ $json.chunkBase64 }}' | base64 -d > "$JOB"; echo "enqueued $JOB"
